title: Conveyor start permissive with guard and fault interlock
nl_spec: A conveyor is started by a momentary StartPB and stopped by a momentary StopPB. Starting is only PERMITTED when the safety guard is closed (GuardClosed = TRUE) and there is no active fault (Fault = FALSE). Once running, the conveyor latches on. It must stop immediately if StopPB is pressed, if the guard opens, or if a fault occurs. Write an IEC 61131-3 Structured Text PROGRAM named conveyor_ctrl with inputs StartPB, StopPB, GuardClosed, Fault and output Conveyor.

safety_properties.nl: The conveyor is never running while the guard is open.
The conveyor is never running while a fault is active.
Whenever the stop button is pressed, the conveyor is off.

scenarios.description: Start with permissives, then guard opens

notes: Start permissive AND latch with multiple stop conditions; combines de-energize priority with a gated start.
